const genreMap = {
  28: "Action",
  12: "Adventure",
  16: "Animation",
  35: "Comedy",
  80: "Crime",
  99: "Documentary",
  18: "Drama",
  10751: "Family",
  14: "Fantasy",
  36: "History",
  27: "Horror",
  10402: "Music",
  9648: "Mystery",
  10749: "Romance",
  878: "Sci-Fi",
  53: "Thriller",
  10752: "War",
  37: "Western"
};
const movies = $json.results.slice(0, 5).map(movie => ({
  title: movie.title,
  overview: movie.overview,
  release_date: movie.release_date,
  vote_average: movie.vote_average,
  poster_path: movie.poster_path,
  director: $('Code in JavaScript5').first().json.director,
  cast: $('Code in JavaScript4').first().json.cast,
  runtime: $('runtime').first().json.runtime,
  genres: movie.genre_ids
    .map(id => genreMap[id])
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" • "),
  trailer:$("Code in JavaScript6").first().json.trailer,
  streaming: $("stream").first().json.results.AD?.flatrate?.[0]?.provider_name || ""
}));

return [{
  json: {
    results: movies
  }
}];

options.systemMessage:
You are an Intent Classification Engine for a Movie Recommendation Bot.

Your ONLY task is to analyze the user's message and return a valid JSON object.

Do NOT recommend movies.
Do NOT explain anything.
Do NOT use markdown.
Do NOT add extra text.
Return ONLY valid JSON.

Supported intents:

1. search
   User is searching for a specific movie.

2. genre
   User wants movies from a genre.

3. language
   User wants movies in a specific language.

4. similar
   User wants movies similar to another movie.

5. actor
   User wants movies starring an actor.

6. director
   User wants movies by a director.

7. trending
   User wants trending movies.

8. top_rated
   User wants top-rated movies.

9. upcoming
   User wants upcoming movies.

10. now_playing
    User wants movies currently in theatres.

11. popular
    User wants popular movies.

12. unknown
    If the intent cannot be determined.
13.Developer
if the intention is about the developer give the intent as developer

Convert values into TMDB-friendly formats.

Languages:
English -> en
Telugu -> te
Hindi -> hi
Tamil -> ta
Malayalam -> ml
Kannada -> kn
Japanese -> ja
Korean -> ko

Genres:

Action -> 28
